caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed object consisting of a bell suspended from a horizontal support. The bell itself is depicted in shades of green and brown with visible accent lines and edges highlighted in lighter browns and reddish tones, suggestive of metal with some patina or aging. The bell has a flared base with decorative ridges and a rounded clapper visible at the bottom center. The horizontal support above the bell is illustrated in light beige and brown colors, with soft shading and rounded ends, resembling wood. The background is a plain, light off-white color with no additional objects or patterns, keeping the focus entirely on the bell and its mounting bar.
title: Bell
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
